The Perceptual Quality Auditor reported 'null' distortions, which contradicts the Router's visual finding of AI-smoothing. As per principles, Router's direct observation of texture anomalies in AI images (often missed by VLMs trained on natural images) is primary. I agree with the Router that the texture is overly smooth (AI artifact), but the severity is moderate (2-3) as it doesn't destroy the form. The lack of noise/compression artifacts noted by the PQ auditor supports a higher artifact score than the reference 'low' quality images.

The background blur is consistent with depth-of-field but lacks natural optical bokeh characteristics. No structural collapses, extra limbs, or severe melting were detected by the Topology or Geometry experts. The image is structurally coherent but texturally artificial. The artifact score is penalized from a perfect 5.0 due to the texture anomaly and slight unnaturalness in lighting/reflection on the fish body.
